How It Works

Three simple steps and you are fresh. No driving across town and no sitting in a crowded shop hoping your name gets called.

Step 1

Book a Time

Fill out the booking form below or call Jimmy. Pick the day and time that fits your life and he locks it in.

Step 2

Jimmy Comes to Your House

He pulls up with his box, sets up in minutes, and turns your space into the barber chair for the day.

Step 3

Get Fresh

You get up looking sharp and get right back to your day. No line, no wait, no trip back home from the shop.

Meet Jimmy

Jimmy is a one man operation. When you book, Jimmy himself pulls up to your house, not a stranger sent out from a shop.

What Jimmy Brings

Jimmy travels light but he travels complete. Everything he needs rides in one box and he sets it all up himself.

  • His ClippersClean, charged, and ready. The same tools he trusts on every single cut.
  • His CapeYou stay clean while he works. The cape goes on and the mess stays off your clothes and your floor.
  • His BoxOne box with everything in it. Guards, combs, trimmers, and all the little things a real cut needs.
  • His MusicYes, he even brings his own music. Good cuts come with good vibes, and Jimmy brings both.
  • Full SetupHe sets up everything when he arrives and packs it all back up before he leaves.
One thing he does not bring is a chair. Yours works just fine, and that is the whole point. Your house, your chair, your cut.

The Services

Pick what you need. Jimmy handles the rest when he gets there.

Haircut

$35

A clean, even cut shaped to your head and your style, finished sharp all the way around. Want a skin fade instead? Low, mid, or high, Jimmy fades it the way you like it.

Beard Trim

$20

Trim, shape, and clean edges for your beard so it looks kept instead of grown out by accident.

Line Up

$15

Crisp edges around the hairline, temples, and neck. The detail work that makes a cut look finished.

Hot Towel Shave

$30

A hot towel first to soften everything up, then a smooth, close shave and a clean, cool finish.

Kids Cut

$25

Patient cuts for young ones right at home, where they are comfortable and you are not chasing them around a shop.

The price you see is the price you pay. Jimmy confirms your time when he calls you back.

Not Sure What Cut Fits You?

That is where Jimmy shines. He adapts to any style you bring him, a photo, an idea, or just a feeling, and he gives you honest ideas that actually work for your head shape and your style.

No guessing and no copy of somebody elses cut that was never going to suit you. Jimmy looks at your head, hears what you want, and builds the cut that fits you.
